name: One With The Shadows
description: A fighter cannot use this ability when visible to enemy fighters or when carrying wyrdstone tokens. Remove this fighter from the battlefield. This fighter is now **hidden**.

name: Skitterleap
description: *Magical ability*. A fighter cannot use this ability while within 1” of an enemy fighter or when carrying a treasure token. Remove this fighter from the battlefield, then set it up on the battlefield floor or on a platform, more than 6” from all enemy warriors, objective markers and treasure tokens.

name: Gnawdoom
description: *Magical ability*. Select a visible enemy fighter within 6” and roll (X) dice. For each roll of 2+, allocate 1 damage points to that enemy fighter.

name: Enshrouding Darkness
description: *Magical ability*. Until the end of the battle round, fighters within (X/2)" of this fighter are not visible to fighters more than 1" away from them.

name: Pack Tactics
description: Select a visible friendly `Henchman` within 3" of this fighter. That fighter makes a free move action or a free attack action.

name: Sigmar’s Blessing
description:
All `Sisters of Sigmar` fighters may call for one of Sigmar’s Blessings by spending saved Wyrd Dice:

- **Hearts of Steel:** When a fighter is asked to take a Bravery test, you may discard one saved Wyrd Dice to automatically pass the test.
- **Righteous Fury:** During a fighter’s activation, after making a hit roll, you may discard one saved Wyrd Dice to turn a miss into a hit.
- **Sigmar Protects:** During an enemy fighter’s activation, you may discard one saved Wyrd Dice to perform a reaction with a fighter without needing or spending an action to do so.

name: Strategize
description: The next time this fighter makes a wait action this activation, roll (X) dice. For each roll of 4+, you may add 1 wyrd dice do your saved wyrd dice.

name: Driven by Greed
description: A fighter can only use this ability if it is carrying, or is within 1” of a wyrdstone token. Add 1 to the Fight and Attacks characteristics of this fighter’s next melee attack action.

name: Hunter’s Eye
description: For this fighter’s next ranged attack action, add 1 to the damage points allocated to the target by each hit and critical hit.

name: Martial Discipline
description: When this fighter is recruited to the warband you may increase it’s Fight or Shoot characteristic by 1.

name: Lead By Example
description: A fighter can use this ability after taking an enemy fighter out of action. Select up to two visible friendly fighters with the `HENCHMAN` keyword within 6” of this fighter. Each of those fighters can make a free move or a free attack action.

name: Give Order
description:
Place an **order token** within 12" of this fighter and select one of the effects below:
- **Seize**: Until the end of the battle round, friendly fighters may add 1 to their Fight or Shoot characteristic when attacking a target within 2" of that token.
- **Hold**: Until the end of the battle round, subtract 1 from the Bravery characteristic of friendly fighters within 2" of that token.

name: Condemn
description: Select up to (X/2) visible enemy fighters. Those fighters are condemned. For each selected fighter, increase Zeal by 1. If the selected fighter is a `WIZARD`, `DAEMON` or `VAMPIRE`, increase Zeal by 3 instead.

name: Incite Rabble
description: Select a friendly `Henchman` within 6” of this fighter. That `Henchman` makes a free move action. Then, increase Zeal by 1.

name: Self-Flagellation
description: Allocate (X/2) damage points to this fighter and increase Zeal by 1. Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee attack actions made by this fighter until the end of their activation.

name: Death Grip
description: After this fighter's next melee attack action in this activation, if any hit roll results in a hit or a critical hit, they must forfeit 1 of their actions in this battle round.

name: Unshakeable
description: This fighter automatically passes any Panic tests it is required to take.

name: Penitent
description: This fighter cannot be equipped with ranged weapons or wear any armour.

name: Words of Healing
description: Remove (X/2) damage points allocated to each friendly fighter within 6" of this fighter. If you discard a saved wyrd dice, remove (X) damage points instead.

name: Hammer of Sigmar
description: Until the end of this fighter's activation, add 1 to the Hit Damage and Critical Damage characteristics of their weapon. In addition, the weapon gains the blessed weapon rule.

name: Soulfire
description: Allocate D3 damage points to each visible enemy fighter within 6” of this fighter. If the enemy fighter is a `Vampire`, `Daemon` or `Thrall`, allocate D3+3 damage points instead.

name: Touch of chaos
description: *Magical ability*. Select a visible fighter within 1” of this fighter. That fighter must take a Bravery test. If the test fails, the fighter is immediately removed from the battlefield. The fighter does not count as taken out of action, but gains the `MUTANT` keyword.

name: Puppet Master
description: *Magical ability*. Select a visible fighter within 6" of this fighter. That fighter must pass a Bravery test or immediately make a free Move, Retreat, or Attack action of your choice (a friendly fighter can choose to automatically fail the Bravery test).

name: Curse of Agony
description: *Magical ability*. Select a visible fighter within 12" of this fighter. Until the end of the battle round, when that fighter makes an action other than the Wait action, allocate (X/2) damage points to that fighter.

name: Armour of Faith
description: This fighter refuses to wear any armour, and is always considered to be in Cover.

name: Ascended
description: In the aftermath sequence, this fighter is always considered to be Marked for Greatness. The Daemon within refuses to be equipped with any equipment, weapons or armour.

name: Hollowed
description: This fighter automatically passes any Bravery tests it is required to take.

name: The Hunger
description: A fighter can use this ability after taking an enemy fighter out of action with a melee attack action. Remove (X) damage points from this fighter, and add a Wyrd Dice to your saved Wyrd Dice.

name: Undying Loyalty
description: A fighter can make this reaction when a `VAMPIRE` within 3" of them is targeted by an attack action, after the damage is totalled but before it is allocated, if it is enough for that `VAMPIRE` to be taken out of action. Allocate those damage points, one at a time, to this fighter instead. If this fighter is taken out of action, allocate any remaining damage points to that friendly `VAMPIRE`.

name: Shambling Horde
description: Select up to (X/2) visible friendly fighters with the `Zombie` keyword. Those fighters can each immediately make a free move action of up to 3", as long as they end that move action closer to this fighter.

name: Chilling Howl
description: Select each enemy fighter within 6” of this fighter. Until the end of the battle round, those fighters cannot make reactions.

name: Whack
description: Select an enemy fighter within 1" of this fighter. That fighter makes a free move action directly away from this fighter, as if it jumped. When making that move action, it can move up to (X"). If it cannot move away from this fighter, allocate (X/2) damage points to that fighter instead.

name: Bodyguard
description: A fighter can make this reaction when a friendly `HERO` within 1" is targeted by an attack action. That attack action targets this fighter instead.

name: Slayer Oath
description: When this fighter is allocated enough damage to take them out of action, before it is removed from the battlefield, this fighter makes a free attack action.

name: Frenzy
description: A fighter can only use this ability if it has been allocated 8 or more damage points. This fighter makes a free melee attack action.

name: Guard
description: When this fighter makes the Wait action, increase it's Fight characteristic by 2 until its next activation.

name: Heckle
description: Select (X/2) enemy fighters that are within 6" of this fighter. Until the end of the battle round, when making attack actions, those fighters must reduce their Fight and Shoot characteristics by 3, unless those attack actions target this fighter.

name: Snatch
description: A fighter can use this ability while within 1" of an enemy fighter carrying a treasure or wyrdstone token. Roll a d6: on a 2+, this fighter steals the token. Then, this fighter makes a free Retreat action.

name: Wither
description: *Magical ability*. Select a visible enemy fighter within 12” of this fighter. That fighter must reduce its Move, Fight and Shoot characteristics by (X/2) until the end of the battle round.

name: Flight of Zimmerman
description:
*Magical Ability.* This fighter makes a free move action, and for that move action, they count as flying. However, while flying, they cannot move vertically upwards more
than (X)".

name: Fires of U'Zhul
description: *Magical ability*. Select an enemy fighter within 12" of this fighter to be the target and roll (X) dice. For each roll of 3+, allocate 2 damage points to the target. For each roll of 6, allocate 2 damage points to all fighters within 2" (and visible to) the target.

name: Stupidity
description: Unless activated within 3" of a visible friendly `HERO` or enemy fighter, roll a die. On a 1-4, this fighter makes a Wait action. On a 5+, this fighter may activate as normal.

name: Bounding Leaps
description: A fighter can only use this ability if there is a visible enemy fighter within 6" of them. This fighter makes a free move action and must finish closer to the closest visible enemy fighter than they were at the start of that move action.

name: Savage Mauling
description: This fighter makes a free melee attack action. Then, you may remove the target of that attack action from the battlefield, and place it back anywhere within 1" of this fighter.

name: Bestial Rage
description: While this fighter is wounded, you may use the 'Onslaught' ability without needing or spending the ability dice to do so.

name: Ramming Charge
description: A fighter can only use this ability if there is an enemy fighter within 6” of it. This fighter makes a free Move action, and must end that move action within 1” of that enemy fighter. Then, allocate (X/2) damage points to that enemy fighter.

name: Denounce
description: A fighter may use this reaction when a visible `Wizard` uses a *magical ability*. Roll a d6: if the result is higher than this fighter’s Bravery characteristic, the ability is cancelled and the ability dice discarded.

name: Incessant Chanting
description: Increase the Bravery characteristic of all visible friendly fighters within 3” of this fighter by 1.

name: Raise Dead
description: Set up a new Zombie wholly within 3" of this fighter, on a platform or the battlefield floor. That Zombie is considered to be a friendly fighter, and can be activated as normal in this battle round. It has (X) damage points remaining. Raised Zombies are not added to the warband roster and crumble to dust at the end of the battle.

name: Transference
description: Allocate up to (X) damage points to a fighter within 12” of this fighter, and then remove the same amount of damage points from a friendly `Thrall` within 3” of this fighter.

name: Vanhel’s Danse Macabre
description: Until the end of the battle round, `THRALLS` activated within (X)” of this fighter may increase their Move characteristic by 2, and their Attacks characteristics by 1.

name: Sudden Accusation
description: A fighter can make this reaction when a visible friendly fighter is taken out of action by a visible enemy fighter. That enemy fighter is condemned. Then, increase Zeal by 1.

name: Baleful Challenge
description: Select a visible enemy fighter within 1” of this fighter. That enemy fighter makes a free melee attack action targeting this fighter. Then, add 2 to the Attacks and Fight characteristic of melee attack actions made by this fighter that targets that enemy fighter until the end of the activation.

name: Unbending Will
description: Do not make injury rolls for this fighter. In addition, when this fighter is taken out of action, the warband starts wavering.

name: Unholy Celerity
description: Once per battle round, this fighter can make a free move action.

name: Unfeeling Flesh
description: When resolving an attack action against this fighter, if none of the hit rolls score a critical hit, add 1 to this fighter's Armour characteristic.

name: Foresight
description: Select a friendly fighter within 6” of this fighter. Until the end of the battle round, all hit rolls targeting that fighter hit on a 5+, no matter the attacker's fight or shoot characteristics.

name: Doom
description: Select each enemy fighter within 6” of this fighter. Until the end of the battle round, those fighters cannot make reactions.

name: Running Death
description: This fighter makes a free move action or free retreat action. In addition, until the end of this fighter's activation, add 1 to the damage points allocated to enemy fighters by each critical hit from melee attack actions made by this fighter.

name: Gory Feast
description: A `GHOUL` can use this ability if an enemy fighter was taken down by an attack action made by them this activation. Remove (X/2) damage points from each friendly `GHOUL` within 2" of this fighter.

name: Fleet of foot
description: Once per activation, this fighter can make a free Move action.

name: Unerring aim
description: Once per battle round, when this fighter makes a ranged attack action with a Bow or Elven Bow and haven’t made a Move action yet in their activation, the weapon gains the **Pierce 1** special rule.

name: Wyrdlung Rot
description: This fighter can only make one Move action per battle round.

name: Crippled leg
description: Subtract 1 from this fighter’s Move characteristic.

name: Damaged Sword Arm
description: Subtract 1 from this fighter’s Fight characteristic.

name: Devastated eye
description: Subtract 1 from this fighter’s Shoot characteristic.

name: Festering wound
description: Subtract 4 from this fighter’s Health characteristic. If this results in a Health characteristic of 0, they die.

name: Nervous tick
description: Add 1 to this fighter’s Bravery characteristic.

name: Hallucinations
description: To this fighter, all enemy fighters are `Terrifying`.

name: Claustrophobia
description: When this fighter is activated or ends a move action underneath a platform, it must pass a Bravery test or become panicked.

name: Alcoholic
description: This fighter cannot make reactions.

name: Sticky Fingers
description: Before collecting income in the aftermath sequence, roll a dice. On a 1-3, reduce the amount of Wyrdstone Shards delivered to your faction by 1 (to a minimum of 0).

name: Paranoia
description: This fighter counts as panicked while within 1” of friendly fighters.

name: Vessel of the Gods
description: When this fighter is deployed to the battlefield, you may add an additional wyrd dice to your saved wyrd dice.

name: Deformed Wings
description: Once per battle round, when this fighter makes a move action, it may count as flying; however, when flying, they cannot move vertically upwards more than 3". In addition, this fighter does not suffer damage when falling, regardless of the distance.

name: Black Blood
description: Whenever this fighter is allocated damage from an attack action that scored a critical hit, allocate 1 damage to every visible fighter within 1”.

name: Temporal Instability
description: Once per battle round, when this fighter makes a Move action, you may subtract 2 from their Move characteristic to treat an obstacle as insignificant terrain.

name: Horrific Appearance
description: This fighter gains the `Terrifying` keyword.

name: Cloud of Flies
description: Subtract 1 from the Fight and Shoot characteristics (to a minimum of 1) of all fighters within 2” of this fighter.

name: Metabolic Overdrive
description: Once per battle round, this fighter can make a free move action. If it does, allocate D3 damage points to this fighter.

name: Rapid Regeneration
description: Each time this fighter is activated, you can remove D3 damage points allocated to them.

name: Daemonic Chitin
description: Add 1 to this fighter's Armour characteristic.

name: Misdirection
description: Use this reaction when an enemy fighter ends a Move action within 3” of this fighter. Remove this fighter from the battlefield, and then set it up again within 3” of its original position.

name: Fool's Gold
description: *Magical Ability.* Select a visible terrain feature, and then select (X/2) enemy fighters within 6” of that terrain feature. The selected fighters must take a Bravery test, those who fail immediately makes a free move action that ends as close to that terrain feature as possible.

name: Mind Razor
description: *Magical Ability.* Select a visible enemy fighter within 12” of this fighter. That fighter cannot make move or retreat actions this battle round. If that fighter has already activated in this battle round, they suffer (X/2) damage points instead.

name: One Step Ahead
description: While this fighter is on the battlefield, you may roll 7 dice in each initiative phase, instead of 6.

name: Call to Battle
description: Until the end of the battle round, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee attack actions made by visible friendly fighters while they are within 6" of this fighter.

name: Drillmaster
description: When earning renown in the aftermath sequence, if this fighter wasn’t taken out of action in the battle, you may select an additional `Henchman` to be marked for greatness.

name: Fearsome
description: This fighter gains the `Terrifying` keyword.

name: Maintain Momentum
description: When this fighter uses the Onslaught ability, it affects each melee attack action they make until the end of their activation, instead of only their next one.

name: Oppressor
description: Once per battle round, when an enemy fighter makes the Retreat action, this fighter can make the ’Cut Them Down’ reaction without having to forfeit an action to do so.

name: Shield Bash
description: This fighter can use a shield to make off-hand attacks. The attack deals no damage, but if the hit roll scores a hit or critical hit, the target makes a free Retreat action. You get to decide where it goes.

name: Staggering Blows
description: Whenever this fighter scores a critical hit with a melee attack action, the target cannot use reactions or abilities for the rest of the battle round.

name: Weapon Master
description: Select a melee weapon type. When making attack actions with weapons of that type, add 1 to its critical damage characteristic.

name: Executioner's Strike
description: *Legendary ability.* This fighter makes a free attack action. Increase the Hit Damage and Critical Damage of that attack action by (X/2).

name: Second Wind
description: Each time this fighter is activated, if it is wounded, you can remove D3 damage points allocated to them.

name: Nine Lives
description: When rolling for permanent injuries, this fighter can re-roll the first result of 11-12. The second result stands.

name: Tough as Nails
description: Increase this fighter's Health characteristic by 4.

name: Bulwark
description: When equipped with a shield, friendly fighters within 1" of this fighter are considered to be in cover.

name: Endure
description: A fighter can make this reaction after they are targeted by an attack action but before the hit rolls are made. Subtract 1 from the damage points allocated by each hit and critical hit (to a minimum of 1) from that attack action.

name: Bodyguard
description: Select a friendly `Hero` within 1” of this fighter. Until the end of the battle round, while that `Hero` remains within 1" of this fighter, they cannot be targeted by attack actions.

name: Indomitable
description: *Legendary ability.* A fighter can only use this ability if an enemy fighter has been taken down by an attack action made by them this activation. Remove up to 10 damage points allocated to this fighter.

name: Acrobatic
description: This fighter can end Retreat actions within 1” of enemy fighters.

name: Duelist
description: Once per battle round, this fighter can make the ’Counter’ reaction without having to forfeit an action to do so.

name: Infiltrator
description: When this fighter is deployed to the battlefield, it may immediately make a free move action, as long as it ends that move action more than 6" from enemy fighters.

name: Stealthy
description: When this fighter is targeted by a ranged attack action, it is considered to be in cover if it is more than 6" away from the attacking fighter.

name: Wall-Runner
description: When this fighter makes the Move action, they may ignore the first 3" moved vertically when climbing or falling.

name: Step-Aside
description: A fighter can make this reaction after they are targeted by a melee attack action but before any hit rolls are made. Roll 1 dice for each successful hit. On a 4+, that hit counts as a miss and is discarded.

name: Disengage
description: A fighter can only use this ability if they are within 1" of an enemy fighter. This fighter makes a free Retreat action.

name: Rain of Blows
description: *Legendary ability.* Add 3 to the Attacks characteristic of melee attack actions made by this fighter until the end of their activation.

name: Eagle Eyes
description: When making an attack action using a bow, crossbow or handgun, this fighter may ignore the maximum range of the weapon, but if they do, they must subtract 1 from their Shoot characteristic.

name: Reckless
description: This fighter may target enemy fighters within 1” of friendly fighters with ranged attack actions. If they do, after making the hit rolls, roll a dice. On a 1, allocate the damage to one of the friendly fighters instead of the target.

name: Rapid Reload
description: At the end of each battle round, you may reload one of this fighter's weapons with the Reload special rule.

name: Scout
description: After making an exploration roll in the aftermath sequence, if the bearer is in the search party, you may resolve two encounters instead of one, even if one of the encounters is a mishap.

name: Surgical Precision
description: This fighter's weapons gain the **Piercing 1** weapon rule.

name: Trick Shot
description: When this fighter makes the ranged attack action, the target does not count as being in cover.

name: Patient Hunter
description: Once per battle round, when an enemy fighter ends a move action visible to this fighter, this fighter can target that enemy fighter with a free ranged attack action. For that attack action, subtract 1 from this fighter's Shoot characteristic.

name: Killing Shot
description: *Legendary ability.* For this fighter's next ranged attack action, add (X/2) to its Shoot, Hit Damage and Critical Damage characteristics.

name: Bootlicker
description: When collecting income in the aftermath sequence, if this fighter was not taken out of action, your warband earns 1 additional favour.

name: Charismatic
description: Once per battle, this fighter can use the ‘Inspiring Presence’ ability without needing or spending ability dice to do so.

name: Master Tactician
description: `Leader` only. When seizing the initiative in the initiative phase, if there is a tie, do not roll off. Instead the player controlling this fighter chooses which tied player has the initiative. If multiple warbands have this talent, the players of those warbands roll off, and the winner chooses which tied player has the initiative.

name: Well-Connected
description: Once per battle when recruiting a `Hired Sword`, roll a dice. On a 4+, you may reduce the hiring fee by 50% (rounding up).

name: Fall Back!
description: A fighter can make this reaction after they have been allocated the total damage points by a melee attack action. This fighter makes a free Retreat action.

name: Warcry
description: Select each friendly fighter within 6” of this fighter. Those fighters are no longer panicked, and do not have to take Bravery tests until the end of the battle round.

name: Coordinated Assault
description: *Legendary ability.* Select 3 friendly `Henchmen` within 6” of this fighter. Each selected fighter makes either a free move action, a free retreat action, or a free attack action.
